_about: Performance budgets (milliseconds, the median of midgard_bench's runs), checked by tools/budgets.py. A benchmark fails when it takes longer than its budget plus the margin. 'default' applies everywhere unless a platform has its own value; CI's platforms are named ci-<preset>, and its Linux jobs render with software Vulkan (lavapipe). Budgets are about 2-3 times the slowest CI timing seen (CI runs 38842790692 and, for the job system with a queue per worker, 38845093430; 15 October 2026; texture transcoding: 38924696676, 16 October 2026), so a real slowdown fails but runner noise doesn't. Every benchmark needs a budget.

physics.step_500_boxes._about: 1.3 ms at most in CI run 38941558221 (Windows and Linux).

terrain.chunk_mesh._about: 0.71 ms at most in CI run 41271876349; the terrain material's moisture and detail (5.9 step 5) take it from 0.6 to 1.0 ms here, about 1.2 ms in CI.

render.cubes_400_offscreen._about: Lavapipe draws on the CPU: about 9 ms with materials and textures (CI run 38920735884), then 26 ms once the frame drew four 2048 x 2048 shadow maps too (run 38929597644), so its budget is 60.

render.cubes_400_phone._about: The phone tier on lavapipe (CPU): 12.2 ms on linux-release and 13.7 ms on linux-arm64 (CI run 38935998601), so its budget is 30.

render.skinned_32_phone._about: 32 skinned characters (8,500 vertices on 65 joints each) with sun shadows, phone quality: 0.35 ms on the development PC's GPU; CI draws on software Vulkan, far slower at vertex work (157 ms on Linux x64, 215 ms on arm64).

render.terrain_hollow_phone._about: Inside a 20 km hollow world (milestone 5.10): about 800 chunks and 700 of water, the far side in about 120 coarse ones. 8.7 ms on an RTX 4070 until the main pass culled draws out of view and drew the ground nearest first; 0.9 ms after (render.cubes_400_phone: 0.24 ms). Lavapipe: 61 ms on linux-release and 113 ms on linux-arm64 (CI run 41317155990), so 150 and 250.

terrain.chunk_mesh_eroded._about: A chunk from a world graph with one erode over 6-octave noise (cost 5 in 5.9 grounds, over kGraphCostBudget's 4, so the cook warns about such a ground): 3.7 ms on the development PC against the plain chunk's 1.1.

anim.retarget_clip._about: A 1.3 s clip (30 keys a second on every joint) retargeted between two 55-joint humanoids: 0.34 ms on the development PC (the Quaternius library's 43 clips are retargeted once, when a character first uses them).

anim.graph_32_characters._about: 32 characters' animation graphs moved on a frame (55 joints; a two-clip blend space, an upper-body layer, root motion and events): 0.23 ms on the development PC (about 7 us a character).

anim.ik_32_characters._about: 32 characters' IK on a frame (55 joints; both legs to the ground with their soles along it, the head looking, a hand reaching): 0.34 ms on the development PC (about 10 us a character).

audio.mix_32_voices._about: 10 ms of 48 kHz stereo mixed from 32 voices on the six buses (each its own volume, pitch and pan), offline: the mixer's whole job each 10 ms on the audio thread, so it must stay well under 10 ms on a phone.

anim.pose_65_joints._about: 100 poses of a 65-joint humanoid sampled from a clip and put in model space: 0.15 ms on the development PC (about 1.5 us a pose; it had 55 joints until 5.13 step 7, and read past their end; the Quaternius library's real clips about 12 us a pose with cold caches).

nav.terrain_tile._about: A 32 m navigation tile over terrain (the ground sampled on a 1 m grid, Recast at 0.3 m cells): 8.3 ms on the development PC, one thread; the game makes them round the player on the job system.

nav.tile_32m._about: A 32 m navigation tile (Recast, 0.2 m cells) over rolling ground with 12 boxes: 7.6 ms on the development PC, one thread (tiles build in parallel on the job system).

terrain.placements_tile._about: Objects placed in one 125 m tile by two rules: 0.25 ms on the development PC (a few hundred candidates, five heights each).

worldgen.classic_35x35._about: The 5.9 ground as a world graph, a chunk's worth of points: 0.62 ms on the development PC (about the terrain's own noise).

worldgen.everything_35x35._about: Every node, two of them neighbourhood filters (erode of smooth): each point evaluates the noise 21 times, 17 ms on the development PC. Too slow for a chunk's 3 ms as it is; step 3 of 5.11 samples filters from the chunk's own grid instead.
